- **Does not answer:** Which mandatory rules of the applicable law restrict the remedies? — the source delegates outwards (PICC_ART7_1_6_EN). THIS IS NOT THE LAW OF A STATE. The Principles apply when the parties have agreed on them, or when a court or arbitral tribunal takes them as general principles of law; they do not replace the mandatory rules of the applicable law (article 1.4, hub `unidroit.picc`).
- **Does not answer:** Is the cure appropriate, is the harm foreseeable and is the impediment insurmountable? — data the case must bring (PICC_ART7_1_4_EN, PICC_ART7_1_7_EN, PICC_ART7_4_4_EN). THE EVALUATIVE ELEMENTS OF CHAPTER 7 GO THROUGH THE §47.3 JUDGMENT CHANNEL with the organ `Tribunal`: the appropriateness of cure and a legitimate interest in refusing it (7.1.4), a reasonable additional period (7.1.5), the gross unfairness of invoking an exemption clause (7.1.6), the unforeseeability and insurmountability of an impediment (7.1.7), an unreasonably burdensome performance and its availability from another source (7.2.2), substantial deprivation of what was expected and disproportionate loss (7.3.1), a reasonable belief in a future fundamental non-performance (7.3.4), foreseeability of the harm (7.4.4), the reasonableness of the place taken as a benchmark for the current price (7.4.6), the appropriateness of the currency of the harm (7.4.12), and a grossly excessive agreed sum (7.4.13).

- **Does not answer:** Is the non-performance fundamental under the Convention on the same facts? — data the case must bring (PICC_ART7_3_1_EN). FUNDAMENTAL NON-PERFORMANCE IS NOT A DEFINITION HERE BUT FIVE CIRCUMSTANCES (article 7.3.1(2)), the fifth of which — disproportionate loss to the non-performing party — works AGAINST termination. Article 25 of the Convention is built differently: one definition with foreseeability. The instruments answer differently on the same facts, and this is observed by case 03.
- **Does not answer:** Is this a contract to be performed at one time or a long-term divisible one? — data the case must bring (PICC_ART7_3_6_EN, PICC_ART7_3_7_EN). ARTICLES 7.3.6 AND 7.3.7 ON RESTITUTION REFER TO SEPARATE REGIMES for contracts to be performed at one time and for long-term contracts to be performed over a period of time. Which one is before us is a fact of the case, not a conclusion of the model.

- **Does not answer:** What is the value of the bank rate for the currency of payment at the place for payment? — data the case must bring (PICC_ART7_4_9_EN). THE SOURCE NAMES THE RATE OF INTEREST, NOT THE NUMBER. Article 7.4.9(2) gives a RULE OF CHOICE in three steps (the bank rate at the place for payment, the same rate in the state of the currency of payment, the rate under the law of that state); the value of the rate is brought by the case. Article 78 of the Convention names not even a rule — and that is what the Principles answer under article 7(2) of the Convention.
- **Does not answer:** What is the amount of the damages in money? — data the case must bring (PICC_ART7_4_2_EN, PICC_ART7_4_3_EN). THE MODEL DOES NOT COMPUTE THE AMOUNT OF DAMAGES: articles 7.4.2–7.4.7 name WHAT is recoverable and what limits it, while the numbers (the difference in prices, the contribution of the aggrieved party, the amount of interest) are brought by the case. The proportion for the loss of a chance (7.4.3(2)) is left to the court for the same reason.

## Summary

Cards 57, boundaries 6, internal links 0; derivable predicates in the CLIR 55, norms 2 — the surface is closed in both directions. The reasons for a particular case come not from the catalogue but from the issues and the why_not of the answer.
